name: XCC_REV_FUND_REQUESTS
description: This table contains a record for each create expense budget entry from revenue enterprise service scheduler process request. The create expense budget entry from revenue report displays the results of this process request using this data.

columns.name: REV_FUNDING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the submission. Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the create expense budget entry from revenue process job that created the row.

columns.name: REV_JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REV_JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Primary ledger identifier for the process request.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: GL accounting period name for the process request.

columns.name: GL_BUDGET_SYNC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the budget entry is synchronized to the general ledger for the process request.

columns.name: GL_BUDGET_SCENARIO
columns.description: Budget scenario used when the budget entry is synchronized to the general ledger for the process request.

columns.name: BUDGET_ENTRY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of budget transaction used to determine the budget balance of the budget entry.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE_CODE
columns.description: Error code when the process ends in an error.

columns.name: BUDGET_IMP_RESULTS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the budget import results report process job to review the import results.

columns.name: BUDGET_JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BUDGET_JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
